module_summary: Empty AXI-lite slave: handshake-only write and read channels (optional skid buffers) that answer every transaction with a DECERR response and zero data.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid; with WVALID triggers awready pulse.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid; required with AWVALID to accept a write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address ready driven by axil_awready register.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready, same register as AWREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid from axil_bvalid, set on accepted write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Response ready; clears bvalid and permits next write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid; accepted when ARREADY high.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready, high while no read response pending.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read response valid from axil_read_valid register.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read response ready; clears read valid.

groups.name: Write channel
groups.description: AW/W acceptance register and write-response valid generating DECERR.

groups.name: Read channel
groups.description: AR acceptance and read-response valid returning zero data DECERR.
